name: Magnesium (glycinate/bisglycinate)
notes: Candidate standalone magnesium ingredient drafted from master research list v2 (2026-09-05), not yet expert-reviewed - same compound (magnesium) already delivered in bundled form by the multivitamin ingredient, so the dose ledger must sum standalone + multivitamin magnesium against the existing supplemental UL. Two distinct evidence angles: exercise-related soreness (dose scales with activity level per source) and sleep quality (small effect, concentrated in people with lower baseline dietary intake).
